system.description:
When purchased, select one religion, Divine Aspect or defined religious tradition. The folio contains symbols, terminology, recognised rites, historical variants and notes on vestments. It grants a +1-item bonus to Recognise Doctrine and Trace Religious Provenance involving that tradition. A different folio is required for another tradition.

Rename the folio for its tradition ("Doctrine Folio: the Chapel of the Open Hand").

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.
